title: Guy Thinks It's Safe To Drive After Drinking Twice The Legal Limit
description:
#news #police #arrest

On February 10th, 2022. A driver was involved in a crash on a ramp. During the contact, the odour of alcohol was detected. When asked, the driver said they had consumed about 11 beers over the past hour, which was normal for them. The person could not finish field tests and was 0.364 on a PBT.
